newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soymeal ends mixed on Brazil, soyoil falters.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soymeal ends mixed on Brazil, soyoil falters.

text.p: CBOT soymeal futures ended mixed with nearby contracts up on market talk that Brazil may soon impose an export tax on soybeans and soymeal, traders said.

"There was talk Brazil might reinstitute some kind of export tax," said Bob Lekberg, Goldenberg-Hehmeyer analyst. "This is the same talk that floated around a few weeks ago. The meal came back very strongly on it."
But neither Brazil's agricultural nor finance ministries knew of a proposal to impose an export tax and Lekberg and others discounted the rumor.
"The (Brazil) Finance Ministry is not formulating any proposal to put a tax on soybean or soymeal exports and knows of no proposal to do so," a spokesman there said.
Soyoil was weakened by the strength in soymeal and ideas supplies were sufficient to meet lackluster demand.

New crop months were pressured by ideas U.S. soybean plantings were progressing well despite a cool, damp spring. USDA on Monday said nine percent of the U.S. soybean crop was seeded as of Sunday, above trade expectations and above the four percent five-year average.
Soymeal ended up $2.70 per ton to down $1.70 while soyoil ended 0.11 cent per lb lower to 0.10 cent higher.
On the day, SAK Futures bought 1,200 lots July soymeal, Refco Inc bought 200 July and 100 August, and Cargill Inc bought 300 July, pit sources said.
ADM and Continental Grain each sold 300 July and Merrill Lynch and Smith Barney each sold 200 July.
In soyoil, Cargill sold 300 lots each July and December and 100 lots August, Dean Witter bought 150 July and Griffin Trading bought 100 July, pit sources said.
In spread action, Dean Witter spread 400 lots July/May at 0.22 cent, premium July, and Produce Grain spread 150 lots July/May at 0.22 to 0.25 cent, premium July.
Soymeal volume was estimated by CBOT at 25,000 lots, compared with Monday's actual volume of 26,723. Soyoil volume was pegged at 15,000 lots, against Monday's actual of 17,738.
